Proving your language skills for doctoral education
Read this page carefully, as failing to follow these instructions may lead to your application being rejected.
Please note that University of Helsinki has a specified list of accepted ways to prove your language skills. You cannot prove your language skills in any way that is not listed on this page. There are no exceptions to this rule.
University of Helsinki demands an indication of academic level language skills in either Finnish, Swedish or English of all applicants. You can prove your skills in any of these three languages – it does not have to be your doctoral dissertation’s language.
When applying for more than one programme and you verify your language skills to them with the same language test, University of Helsinki needs to receive the test result only once.
You can prove your English language skills with either one of the language tests listed below or with your educational background in the cases listed below.
Language tests
Please note:
Your language test score must be valid throughout the entire application period. This means that if your language test expires even one day before the final application deadline, your score will not meet the requirements set by the University of Helsinki.
A language test must be completed by the end of the application period.
You cannot demonstrate language proficiency by combining parts of the following methods or different sittings of the same method. You must meet the minimum requirements for all elements with the same score report/certificate.
Check the validity of your test score and make arrangements for a new language test well in advance, if necessary.
Only the tests listed below are accepted. Other tests by the same organisers are not accepted.
IELTS Academic
Minimum requirement:
Overall score 6.5, with a minimum score of 6.0 in all sections (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking).
Please note that the University of Helsinki only accepts IELTS Academic test scores. Tests taken at the general level are not accepted.
IELTS for UKVI and IELTS Online tests at academic level are also accepted.
IELTS with One Skill Retake are also accepted.
How to submit the test report form:
You can submit your IELTS results in one of the following ways:
IELTS Academic, IELTS for UKVI and IELTS Online:
Share your test report form to the University of Helsinki through the test organiser's own service.
or
Upload a copy of your test report form to the application form. Your results will be verified from the test organiser.
It is advisable to book your test date well before the application period has started as it may take some time after the test date for your test score to be published.
IELTS scores are valid for two years and the score must be valid throughout the application processing period. This means that the test score must not expire before to the deadline for supplementing the application.
Please note: If your test score expires right after the deadline for supplementing the application, please submit your test score so that it is valid for at least two weeks after submitting.
TOEFL
Minimum requirement:
TOEFL iBT (Internet-based) completed before 21st January, 2026:
Total score 92, a minimum score of 22 in the writing section
TOEFL iBT (Internet-based) completed on or after 21st January, 2026:
Total score 4,5, with a minimum score of 4 in each section (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking)
The Home Edition and Paper Edition of TOEFL iBT are also accepted.
How to submit the score report:
Share your score report directly to the University of Helsinki (institution code 9872) from the test organiser
or
Upload a copy of your score report as a PDF file to the application system. Your results will be verified from the test organiser.
It is advisable to book your test date well before the application period has started, as it may take some time after the test date for your test score to be published.
TOEFL scores are valid for two years and your test score must be valid throughout the application processing period. This means it must not expire prior to the deadline for supplementing the application.
Please note: If your test score expires right after the deadline for supplementing the application, please submit your test score so that it is valid for at least two weeks after submitting.
Cambridge English: C1 Ad­vanced or C2 Pro­fi­ciency
Cambridge English: C1 Ad­vanced (formerly CAE) or C2 Pro­fi­ciency (formerly CPE)
Minimum requirement:
for C1 Advanced (formerly CAE): Pass levels A, B or C
for C2 Proficiency (formerly CPE): Pass levels A, B, C or level C1 certificate
How to submit the test results:
Share your test score directly from the Candidate Results website to the University of Helsinki
or
Upload a copy of your Statement of Results that includes your Statement of Results Number to the application system. Your results will be verified from the test organiser.
It is advisable to book your test date well before the application period has started, as it may take some time after the test date for your test score to be published.
Please note that only tests taken after 2005 are accepted. Please also note that the University of Helsinki only accepts C1 Advanced and C2 Proficiency, no other Cambridge language tests are accepted.
PTE Academic
Minimum requirement:
Overall score 68, with a minimum score of 61 in the writing section.
PTE Academic Online version of the test is also accepted.
How to submit the test score:
Upload a copy of your test score with your Score Report Code in the application system. Your results will be verified from the test organiser.
It is advisable to book your test date well before the application period has started, as it may take some time after the test date for your test score to be published.
PTE Academic scores are valid for two years and the score must be valid throughout the application processing period. This means that the test score must not expire before the deadline for supplementing the application.
Please note: If your test score expires right after the deadline for supplementing the application, please submit your test score so that it is valid for at least two weeks after submitting.
National Certificate of Language Proficiency (YKI)
The is a language test organized by the Finnish National Agency for Education.
Minimum requirement:
Skills level 5 in all sub-tests: speaking, listening comprehension, writing and reading comprehension.
How to submit the test score:
Upload the copy of your test score as a PDF file in the application system.
Your results will be verified from the test organiser.
Educational background
In some cases you can prove your English language proficiency with your educational background.
Please note:
If the country of your education is not listed below, your degree cannot be used to prove your English skills
If you prove your English skills with a degree that is not yet completed, you must graduate before the deadline for accepting an offered study right.
You cannot prove your English skills with another incomplete degree.
University degree completed in English (see list of accepted countries)
You can prove your language skills with a university degree (Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Doctoral degree, or polytechnic/university of applied science degree) completed in English in one of the following countries:
EU/EEA countries or Switzerland

Please note that your degree/programme must be taught and assessed entirely in English.
Your educational documents must clearly state that the language of instruction for your degree was English.
If your university degree includes courses or diploma-level qualifications that have been completed outside of the specified countries/area, or courses conducted in a language other than English, the degree might not meet the requirement.
Online studies or studies completed on offshore campuses outside the accepted countries/area can also be used to indicate language skills, if the degree-awarding main institution is based in one of the accepted countries.
Upload a copy of your degree certificate and transcript of records to the application form.
Foreign language studies in English as part of a Finnish university or university of applied sciences degree
You can prove your language skills with a degree completed in a Finnish university or university of applied sciences if you have demonstrated foreign language proficiency in the English language in accordance with the Government Decree on University Degrees (794/2004) or University of Applied Sciences Degrees (1129/2014).
Upload a copy of your degree certificate and transcript of records that show that you have met the foreign language proficiency requirement in the English language to the application form.
If your degree is incomplete, the course that meets the foreign language proficiency requirement must be registered in your transcript of records by the deadline for submitting application enclosures.
Upper-secondary education conducted in English (see list of accepted countries)
You can prove your language skills with upper-secondary education conducted in English in the following countries:
Nordic Countries (Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway, and Sweden)
Australia
Canada
Ireland
New Zealand
United Kingdom
United States of America
Upload a copy of your diploma to the application form
If your upper-secondary education was completed in the Nordic countries, the language of instruction must be stated on the diploma.
International Baccalaureate® (IB)
You can prove your language skills with the or the , if your programme has been completed in English.
If your IB examination has been completed in a language other than English, you can prove your language skills with the the following grades:
English as the A1 language with a minimum grade of 2.
English as the A2 language with a minimum grade of 5.
English as A language (literature/language and literature/literature and performance) with a minimum grade of 2.
Upload a copy of your diploma and grades to the application form.
Alternatively you can and ask them to send it to the Admission Services of the University of Helsinki. University of Helsinki will get the final grades electronically from IBO.
European Baccalaureate
You can prove your language skills with the . The following grades are accepted as proof of language skills:
European Baccalaureate with English as the L1 language with an approved grade
minimum grade of 4 if the examination was taken before 2021
minimum grade of 5 if the examination was taken in 2021 or after.
European Baccalaureate with English as the L2 language with a minimum grade of 7.
Upload a copy of your diploma and grades to the application form.
Degree completed at a Finnish university with English as the major subject
You can prove your language skills with a degree completed at a Finnish university with English as the major subject.
Upload a copy of your degree certificate and transcript of records to the application form.
Please note that degrees completed in other countries with English as the major subject are only accepted as proof of language skills if the degree also fulfills the requirements mentioned above
